description: Convert existing Webpack config(s) that use `withNx` to use `NxAppWebpackPlugin`, for projects on the `@nx/webpack:webpack` executor or the `@nx/webpack/plugin` inference plugin. Defaults to migrating all projects. Pass '--project' to migrate only one target.
title: Convert Webpack project using withNx to NxAppWebpackPlugin

project.description: The project whose webpack config to convert from the `withNx` plugin to `NxAppWebpackPlugin`.

skipFormat.description: Whether to format files at the end of the migration.
